name: Distributor / Store Invoice Sub-Agent
title: Never86 report sub — Inventory / Par / Ordering / Distributor / Store Invoice
description: Owns the Distributor / Store Invoice report (Preferred: emailed PDF/CSV invoices (Sysco, PFS, beer houses, Northern Lights). As-is pain evidence: phone photos + Register#2 payout↔store receipts). Ingests email, pdf, csv, photo. Signals: vendor, sku, qty, amount, account, payout_pair, handwritten_credit, email_forward, source_channel. Routes findings up to the domain parent; teach labels via Report Teacher.
source_report: Preferred: emailed PDF/CSV invoices (Sysco, PFS, beer houses, Northern Lights). As-is pain evidence: phone photos + Register#2 payout↔store receipts

teach_memory.label: keep
teach_memory.as_is: Phone photos of paper invoices + payout slips stapled to store receipts — human, non-repeatable weekly grind.
teach_memory.truth: Distributors already email invoices; operators still print/photograph instead of routing email into a system.
teach_memory.coach_to: Forward/auto-route email invoices into Never86 vendor-invoice intake — remove the human photo/staple loop; store cash runs stay exceptional.
teach_memory.good_looks_like: Email PDF/CSV invoices land in a repeatable inbox → normalized vendor/sku/qty/amount. Phone photos are teach evidence of pain, not the target workflow.
